newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Zhenhai to shutdown 100,000-bpd CDU this weekend.
newsitem.headline: Zhenhai to shutdown 100,000-bpd CDU this weekend.

text.p: China's Zhenhai Refining & Chemical Co Ltd will shutdown a five million tonne-per-year (100,000-barrel-per-day) crude unit this weekend for a scheduled month-long maintenance, a source close to the company said on Thursday.
"We will shut the number one crude unit in the next two to three days," the source said.
The company had originally scheduled the maintenance in March but it postponed it to April following unexpectedly strong demand for petroleum products.
The source said the company will also shutdown a 30,000-bpd fluid catalytic cracker and a 800,000 tonne-per-year (17,000-bpd) coking unit at the same time.
He said currently there were no plans to shutdown a second crude unit for maintenance once the first unit completes its turnaround.
Zhenhai had earlier said it would shutdown the smaller 60,000-bpd crude unit when maintenance works on the first unit is completed.
